name: Sure Grandma, Let's Get You to Bed
look: A stock photo in a sunny garden. An elderly woman with curly white hair, a pearl necklace and a pink cardigan leans on a walker, while a young woman with curly dark hair, in a turquoise T-shirt and jeans, gently guides her by the shoulder and arm.
use: Someone says something outdated, delusional or wildly out of touch, and the reply humors them like a confused grandparent: "Sure grandma, let's get you to bed." The grandma stands for whoever made the claim.
slots: the outdated or delusional claim (top, said by grandma)
the humoring reply, usually "Sure grandma, let's get you to bed" (bottom)
examples: Me at 11 PM: I'll just watch one more episode
Sure grandma, let's get you to bed
My old laptop: I can totally run this new game
Sure grandma, let's get you to bed

girl guiding her grandma on a walker in a garden

caretaker humoring an old woman and taking her to bed
stock photo of a teen helping her grandmother walk outside
origin: A stock photo of a young woman helping an elderly woman walk with a walker.
